name: dev-flow
description: An npx-installable development workflow with delegated implementation, conditional review, human checkpoints, and bundled companion skills.

interface.shortDescription: From requirements to checked and confirmed PR merges.
interface.longDescription: Routes intent, delegates implementation and required independent review to subagents, and handles CI, repairs, confirmed merge, and cleanup. Small feature and UI-only changes skip automatic review. Includes four companion skills, optional execution contracts, and evidence receipts in one installable directory. Project rules remain in AGENTS.md.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-flow for this request. Wait for my confirmation of the ticket breakdown and final PR merge.
